direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh at 1366x768, overflow hidden; 48px header, 40px compact horizontal rail, minmax(0,1fr) main, 56px action bar; rendered cinematic scene at least 70% of main with independent reserved zones for callouts, stations and jobs, no overlap; all targets at least 36px, rail items equal-width and non-wrapping with aria-current and arrow-key movement
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22), silver #C5CCD4, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68), emerald #A8F04A with #050705 text and one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, x marker and plain OFFLINE text; official immutable logo in black, emerald and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly header and opening-story placements
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px; header tabs span most of header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step, minimal narration
direction.motion: Living material flow along real feasible routes, state glow, depth and cinematic 240-320ms transitions on state change; 160-220ms ease-out for selection; prefers-reduced-motion removes flow, glow animation and transitions while pattern, x marker and OFFLINE text retain meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; compact horizontal rail only; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene; separate reserved headings, status and controls for provider-identity connection readiness and the investigation evidence task; action bar with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens one-click Approve then Authorize this decision wall; pending task proposal deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and an approved recovery plan may coexist while replacement tasks await approval; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG filling the reserved scene: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with x marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend using colour, pattern, marker and text

fixes.change: Enlarge scene depth and living flow between Receiving, cells and jobs so the held material state reads cinematically at a glance.
Raise rail and station micro-labels to at least 12px and verify every header tab label is at least 16px.
Add persistent legend with Held, Available and At Risk shown by text plus marker, not colour alone.
Separate provider-identity connection readiness from the investigation evidence task with distinct headings, status and controls in the side zone.
Make verified findings scannable at 16px: enlarge the 0/0/3 metrics and keep Read full analysis inside the reserved zone without crowding.
Link each finding bidirectionally to its factory node with emerald glow on hover and keyboard focus.
After selecting a path, surface one-click Approve followed by the Authorize this decision wall; keep Review recovery option disabled until selection.
Draw the feasible route for the focused path through the scene with living flow, leaving non-feasible routes silver and static.
Align finish and incremental cost columns in tabular figures for faster tradeoff scanning.
Keep proposed tasks visually untracked until approval, with dashed silver treatment distinct from the accepted plan tasks.
Add state glow and a short cinematic trace from the accepted decision into t1, t2 and t3 when the board first appears.
Enlarge side-zone task detail type to 16px body and keep the Approve action as the sole primary.
Add plain OFFLINE text and an x marker alongside the cross-hatching on the previewed CELL-MILL-2 so the stopped state never relies on pattern alone.
Animate the capacity preview 24h to 0h as a cinematic silver drain on the line, frozen under reduced motion.
Raise the machine selector label and status copy to full 16px body size.
Keep connection readiness for provider identity visibly separate from the Reinvestigate evidence control and its offline sample status.
Restore feasible emerald flow only through CELL-MILL-1 and show no route through the cross-hatched OFFLINE CELL-MILL-2.
Fill the empty findings zone with its collapsed status at 16px so the reserved zone never reads as missing content.
Mirror the scene by marking Split available capacity as constrained in both zones with cross-hatching, x marker and plain text reason.
Highlight the two remaining feasible paths with living emerald flow when their side-zone rows receive hover or focus.
Strengthen the invalidated-acceptance status with an icon plus text while retaining the silver and emerald palette.
Show the 3 blocked prior tasks distinctly from the 3 proposed replacements so blocked work and the approved revised plan coexist legibly.
Mark CELL-MILL-2 OFFLINE in the station zone with cross-hatching and x marker, matching steps 6 and 7.
Add a cinematic trace from the revised decision into the replacement tasks, static under reduced motion.
Enlarge the side-zone evidence controls and passphrase guidance to 16px body while keeping Verify ledger as the sole primary.
Animate the verified chain as a single emerald trace across 01 to 03 on verification, then leave it static.
Give locked stages pattern plus LOCKED text and a clear unlock condition so state is not carried by dashed borders alone.
Refit department cards so titles and counts are never clipped: Saw, CNC mills, CNC lathes, Heat treat, Inspection, Finishing and Assembly must render fully inside their zones.
Reconcile machine counts with the icons shown, for example CNC mills 12 machines with sub-counts summing correctly, and make running machines visibly emerald with living flow between departments.
Show stopped machines with silver cross-hatching, x marker and plain OFFLINE text at legible size, and reserve a clear feasible-recovery route in emerald before acceptance.
Enlarge the full-shop cascade visual so department names, OFFLINE labels and the emerald recovery flow are legible without zooming, preserving the required presentation order.
Sharpen the hero contrast where headline type crosses the machinery image so the opening story reads instantly.
Add a one-line outcome metric beside the Live demo link to convert judge attention into a click faster.
